```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_load.R")

USE_ANOVA <- TRUE  # TRUE = 2-way RM ANOVA (condition x electrode) | FALSE = paired t-test

PARADIGM    <- "active"
LOCK        <- "resp"
DATE_SOURCE <- "20261015"
CSD_LABEL   <- "NOCSD"
BC_LABEL    <- "bc-200-100"
CLUSTER     <- c("P1", "Pz", "P2", "POz")

OUTPUT_RESULTS <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/load/resp_p3/"
DATA_ROOT      <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/load/"
DATE_STR       <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

included_participants <- if (params$cohort == "n35") INCLUDED_ACTIVE_N35 else INCLUDED_ACTIVE
n        <- length(included_participants)
n_source <- length(INCLUDED_ACTIVE)

fname <- glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_{PARADIGM}_{n_source}p_load_resp_{BC_LABEL}_{CSD_LABEL}_p3.csv")
path  <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, fname)

df_all <- read.csv(path) %>%
  filter(participant %in% included_participants,
         ch_name %in% CLUSTER,
         window == "-100-100ms") %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS),
         ch_name   = factor(ch_name,   levels = CLUSTER))

df_avg <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(participant, condition, window) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_amp_uv = mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("Loaded:", length(unique(df_all$participant)), "participants\n")
cat("Windows:", paste(sort(unique(df_all$window)), collapse=", "), "\n")
```

```{r overview}
cat(glue(

**Windows tested**: {paste(sort(unique(df_avg$window)), collapse=' | ')}
```

## Statistical Approach

For each window, we test data from all electrodes in the parietal cluster (P1, Pz, P2, POz) using a 2 (condition: Simple, Complex) × electrode repeated-measures ANOVA. The electrode main effect and the electrode × condition interaction are reported for completeness; neither is a confirmatory hypothesis here.

The condition main effect is the confirmatory test. Because condition has exactly two levels, its frequentist F-test is mathematically equivalent to a paired t-test on the same data averaged across cluster electrodes — F(1, df) = t(df)². We therefore report the Bayesian companion to the condition effect as a paired t-test (`BayesFactor::ttestBF`, JZS prior, r = .707) on the electrode-averaged data per participant, condition, and window.

## Results per window

```{r analysis, results='asis'}
summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()

windows <- sort(unique(df_all$window))

for (win in windows) {
  cat(glue("\n### {win}\n\n"))

  df_win     <- df_all[df_all$window == win, ]
  df_win_avg <- df_avg[df_avg$window == win, ]
  n_valid    <- length(unique(df_win$participant))
  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} participants\n\n"))

  # Boxplot on cluster average
  df_win_avg[["condition"]] <- factor(df_win_avg[["condition"]], levels = CONDITION_LEVELS)
  p <- ggplot(df_win_avg, aes(x = condition, y = mean_amp_uv, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CONDITION_COLORS) +
    labs(title    = glue("Mean Amplitude — {win}"),
         subtitle = glue("N = {n_valid} | {paste(CLUSTER, collapse='+')}"),
         x = NULL, y = "Mean amplitude (uV)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  print(p); cat("\n")

  label_suffix <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", win)

  if (USE_ANOVA) {
    df_win[["condition"]] <- factor(df_win[["condition"]], levels = CONDITION_LEVELS)
    df_win[["ch_name"]]   <- factor(df_win[["ch_name"]],   levels = CLUSTER)

    # Normality on residuals
    res_aov <- aov(mean_amp_uv ~ ch_name * condition, data = df_win)
    resids  <- residuals(res_aov)
    shapiro <- shapiro.test(resids)
    cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk** (residuals): W = {round(shapiro$statistic[[1]], 3)}, p = {round(shapiro$p.value, 3)}\n\n"))

    res_rm <- anova_test(
      data        = df_win,
      dv          = mean_amp_uv,
      wid         = participant,
      within      = c("ch_name", "condition"),
      type        = 2,
      effect.size = "pes"
    )

    tbl     <- get_anova_table(res_rm, correction = "auto")
    gg      <- res_rm$`Sphericity Corrections`
    mauchly <- res_rm$`Mauchly's Test for Sphericity`

    cat("**Repeated-measures ANOVA:**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(tbl, digits = 3)); cat("\n")

    if (!is.null(mauchly) && nrow(mauchly) > 0) {
      cat("**Mauchly's Test:**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(mauchly, digits = 3)); cat("\n")
    }
    if (!is.null(gg)) {
      cat("**Sphericity Corrections:**\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(gg, digits = 3)); cat("\n")
    }

    # Bayesian condition effect (collapsed across electrodes)
    df_wide_cond <- df_win_avg %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = condition,
                  values_from = mean_amp_uv, names_prefix = "mean_amp_uv.") %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("mean_amp_uv."), as.numeric)) %>%
      drop_na()

    cond_bf <- tryCatch({
      run_paired_ttest(df_wide_cond, CONDITION_LEVELS)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(glue("> Warning: Bayesian condition test failed for {win}: {e$message}\n\n"))
      NULL
    })

    if (!is.null(cond_bf)) {
      cat(glue("**Bayesian paired t-test (condition)**: BF10 = {format_bf(cond_bf$bf10)}, BF01 = {format_bf(cond_bf$bf01)}\n\n"))
    }

    # APA
    apa_parts <- character(nrow(tbl))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(tbl))) {
      term  <- tbl[["Effect"]][i]
      f_val <- round(tbl[["F"]][i], 2)
      df1   <- tbl[["DFn"]][i]
      df2   <- tbl[["DFd"]][i]
      p_val <- tbl[["p"]][i]
      eta   <- round(tbl[["pes"]][i], 3)
      p_str <- format_p(p_val)
      gg_note <- ""
      if (!is.null(gg) && term %in% gg[["Effect"]]) {
        idx <- which(gg[["Effect"]] == term)
        eps <- round(gg[["GGe"]][idx], 2)
        if (!is.null(mauchly)) {
          m_idx <- which(mauchly[["Effect"]] == term)
          if (length(m_idx) > 0 && mauchly[["p"]][m_idx] < .05)
            gg_note <- glue(", GGe corrected, epsilon = {eps}")
        }
      }
      bf_note <- ""
      if (term == "condition" && !is.null(cond_bf)) {
        bf_note <- glue(", BF10 = {format_bf(cond_bf$bf10)}")
      }
      apa_parts[i] <- glue("{term}: F({df1}, {df2}) = {f_val}, {p_str}, pes = {eta}{gg_note}{bf_note}")
      cat(glue("- {apa_parts[i]}\n\n"))
    }
    cat("\n")

    apa <- paste(apa_parts, collapse = "; ")

    tbl_df <- data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    tbl_df[["window"]]     <- win
    tbl_df[["gg_epsilon"]] <- NA_real_
    if (!is.null(gg)) {
      for (eff in gg[["Effect"]]) {
        idx <- which(tbl_df[["Effect"]] == eff)
        if (length(idx) > 0)
          tbl_df[["gg_epsilon"]][idx] <- round(gg[["GGe"]][gg[["Effect"]] == eff], 3)
      }
    }
    tbl_df[["BF10"]] <- NA_real_
    tbl_df[["BF01"]] <- NA_real_
    if (!is.null(cond_bf)) {
      idx <- which(tbl_df[["Effect"]] == "condition")
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        tbl_df[["BF10"]][idx] <- round(cond_bf$bf10, 3)
        tbl_df[["BF01"]][idx] <- round(cond_bf$bf01, 3)
      }
    }
    summary_rows[[win]] <- tbl_df

  } else {
    # Paired t-test fallback
    df_wide <- df_win_avg %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = condition,
                  values_from = mean_amp_uv, names_prefix = "mean_amp_uv.") %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("mean_amp_uv."), as.numeric)) %>%
      drop_na()

    results <- run_paired_ttest(df_wide, CONDITION_LEVELS)
    t_res   <- results$t; d_res <- results$d
    bf10    <- results$bf10; bf01 <- results$bf01
    df_long <- results$df_long

    col_a <- paste0("mean_amp_uv.", CONDITION_LEVELS[1])
    col_b <- paste0("mean_amp_uv.", CONDITION_LEVELS[2])
    shapiro <- shapiro.test(df_wide[[col_a]] - df_wide[[col_b]])
    cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk**: W = {round(shapiro$statistic[[1]], 3)}, p = {round(shapiro$p.value, 3)}\n\n"))

    cat(glue("**Bayesian paired t-test**: BF10 = {format_bf(bf10)}, BF01 = {format_bf(bf01)}\n\n"))

    means <- c(mean(df_wide[[col_a]], na.rm=TRUE), mean(df_wide[[col_b]], na.rm=TRUE))
    sds   <- c(sd(df_wide[[col_a]],  na.rm=TRUE), sd(df_wide[[col_b]],  na.rm=TRUE))

    apa <- apa_ttest(t_res, d_res, bf10, glue("Mean Amplitude {win}"), "parietal", "", "",
                     CONDITION_LEVELS, means, sds)
    summary_rows[[win]] <- build_summary_row(
      glue("Mean Amplitude {win}"), "parietal", "", "",
      CONDITION_LEVELS, means, sds, t_res, d_res, bf10, bf01
    )
  }

  cat(glue("**APA:** {apa}\n\n"))
  apa_texts[[win]] <- apa
}
```

## Summary Table

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
summary_df <- summary_df[, c("window", setdiff(names(summary_df), "window"))]
knitr::kable(summary_df, digits = 3,
             caption = "LOAD | ACTIVE | Response-Locked P3 | Parietal cluster")
```

```{r save-summary}
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Summary saved.\n")
```
